news.title: Jack Dorsey's Block nears 9,000 bitcoin in treasury after Q1 addition
news.summary: The firm added 114 BTC to its corporate treasury, for a total of 8,997 BTC, and said it plans to issue regular third-party reports.

news.summary: Bitcoin drops after repeated resistance at $80,000, taking ether with it, while derivatives and macro signals point to reduced risk appetite and subdued volatility.

news.title: New wallet offers way to tackle Bitcoin’s quantum risk without a fork
news.summary: The Postquant Labs project uses Arch Network to deliver post-quantum signature protection without a Bitcoin soft fork, sidestepping both Jameson Lopp's freeze proposal and Paul Sztorc's hard fork.

news.title: Not a theft, but a statement: Inside the Bitcoin proposal to reassign Satoshi-linked coins
news.summary: Paul Sztorc says he can't move a single sat of Satoshi's bitcoin and isn't trying to. But critics say rewriting forked-chain balances at addresses a user does not control sets a bad precedent.
